title: Co-Branded Card Qualifying Bonus on Retro-Credited Summit Segments
content:
In the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program, a retro-credited segment earns a card qualifying bonus that follows the Crestline co-branded card the member holds and how the segment's ticket was paid. The card is shown by a companion certificate issued on a card anniversary under the Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes charter; the payment is shown by the ticket's record under the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter.

**Rule.** The bonus is a percent of the share qualifying dollars, which are the eligible fare multiplied by the qualifying share percent, rounded to the cent; it is rounded to the cent and added to the qualifying dollars the segment posts.

| Ticket paid by credit card | Card-anniversary companion certificate | Issued within the last 12 months | Bonus |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Crestline Companion Certificate First or Premium Economy | Yes | 10 percent of share qualifying dollars |
| Yes | Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin or Main Plus | Yes | 5 percent of share qualifying dollars |

Any other segment adds no card qualifying bonus.

**Recency.** A certificate is issued within the last 12 months when fewer than 12 whole calendar months have passed from its issue date to the day of posting. Hypothetical boundary: a certificate issued on 15 March 2025 is within the span on 14 March 2026 (11 whole months) and outside it on 15 March 2026 (12 whole months).

**Hypothetical figures.** Share qualifying dollars of 480.00 USD on a ticket paid by credit card, with a Crestline Companion Certificate Premium Economy issued five months ago, give a bonus of 48.00 USD; with a Crestline Companion Certificate Main Plus, 24.00 USD. The same ticket paid other than by credit card gives no bonus.
